text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":3,"unit":"days","kind":"count","span":"an extra arm every three days"},{"id":"q2","value":5,"unit":"days","kind":"count","span":"an extra leg every five days"},{"id":"q3","value":15,"unit":"days","kind":"count","span":"after fifteen days"}],"plan":[{"op":"div","args":["q3","q1"],"out":"s1","note":"days elapsed divided by the arm-growth interval gives how many arms grow"},{"op":"div","args":["q3","q2"],"out":"s2","note":"days elapsed divided by the leg-growth interval gives how many legs grow"},{"op":"add","args":["s1","s2"],"out":"s3","note":"arms plus legs gives total new limbs"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"total new limbs grown after fifteen days"},"dismissed":[]}
